dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped light-colored patterns are visible along the dorsal ridge. These features exhibit sharp high-contrast transitions from dark perimeters to lighter interiors. One large 'C' shaped structure is centrally located near the highest point of the dorsal curve, opening posteriorly.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, solid, high-intensity light-grey blobs clustered across the lateral mid-section. These pixel clusters lack internal gradients and are distributed in asymmetrical, non-uniform groups.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most defined macro-annuli on the upper dorsal surface form a wide obtuse triangle. On the lower lateral flank, four distinct high-intensity blobs form an irregular, elongated quadrilateral configuration.

other_distinctive_markers: The overall texture across the mid-body forms a complex, interlocking reticulated network where light annuli and solid blobs merge into a continuous web-like pattern.
